description: Find US companies that just raised private funding, from SEC Form D notices read directly from SEC EDGAR. Filter by filing window (filed_within_days, or date_from and date_to), states, Form D industry_groups, name_keywords, and min_amount_usd. Funds, SPVs, and real estate projects are dropped by default. Returns one row per round: company_name, company_domain with domain_confidence (kept only when the company's own homepage names it), filing_date, first_sale_date, amount_sold_usd, amount_offered_usd, security_types (equity, debt, SAFE), investor_count, industry_group, entity_type, year_of_incorporation, street, city, state, zip_code, issuer_phone, related_persons (executives and directors with roles), cik, accession, and filing_url. A Form D names no round label and no investors; round_label and press_url come only from a matching headline with include_press. When nothing matches, one free no_results row says why; bad input returns one free input_invalid row. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per round row returned plus a run start.

date_from.description: Start of a custom filing window, YYYY-MM-DD. The window is at most 92 days.

date_to.description: End of a custom filing window, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

exclude_industry_groups.description: Drop these Form D industry groups. The actor default drops Pooled Investment Fund, Commercial, Residential, REITS and Finance, and Other Real Estate; send an empty list to keep them.

exclude_spvs.description: Drop SPVs and funds (3(c) exemptions, pooled fund interests, SPV or Fund in the name). Default true.

filed_within_days.description: Filing window in days ending today, 1 to 90, today included. Ignored when date_from is set. Default 7.

include_amendments.description: Also return Form D/A amendments. Default false.

include_press.description: Add a matching funding headline for the 50 largest rounds through the Mamba Labs News and Media Mention Monitor, which bills its own article events (up to 100 a run) to your Apify account. Default false.

industry_groups.description: Keep only these Form D industry groups, such as Other Technology, Computers, Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Business Services, Retailing, Manufacturing.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_rounds.description: Round rows per run, newest filing first, up to 2000. Each round row is billed. Default 100.

min_amount_usd.description: Keep a round only when the larger of amount offered and amount sold is at least this many USD. Default 100000; 0 keeps every size.

name_keywords.description: Words in the company name, such as AI or Bio.

only_new.description: Skip rounds an earlier run with the same state_key returned. Default false.

resolve_domains.description: Find each company's domain and keep it only when its homepage names the company. No extra charge. Default true.

state_key.description: Names the seen list for only_new.

states.description: Two character state codes of the company's principal place of business, such as CA, NY, or TX.

name: find_recent_funding_rounds
title: Find recent funding rounds
